## Key Projects

### 1. MyRelma — Multi-Tenant Career Coaching SaaS
- **Role**: Lead Architect & Backend Engineer (Led 3-person team)
- **Timeline**: Jun 2025 – Present
- **Category**: Multi-Tenant SaaS & Generative AI
- **Stack**: NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, TypeORM, Redis, BullMQ, FastAPI, CrewAI, OpenAI GPT-4o, Pinecone, Pusher, Cloudflare R2
- **Key Highlights**:
  - Architected and built 27-module NestJS REST API with PostgreSQL/TypeORM multi-tenant isolation from scratch.
  - Onboarded and supported 20+ tenant organizations maintaining 99%+ uptime post-launch.
  - Engineered background job processing with Redis and BullMQ across 10 distinct queues.
  - Built Generative AI career assistant microservice (FastAPI + CrewAI + OpenAI GPT-4o + Pinecone RAG) with 6 production endpoints spanning resume parsing (PDF/DOCX/Images), rewriting, audit scoring, and email drafting.
  - Implemented SSE-streamed conversational resume chat with LLM classifier routing across 9 message types (62K+ lines of service logic).
  - Integrated Google Workspace (Gmail sync, Contacts, Calendar, Tasks) and LinkedIn OAuth directly into the platform.
  - Engineered Redis-backed distributed rate limiting with Postgres failover, per-email auth throttling, and Helmet HTTP hardening.

### 2. IMS Link — Inventory Management System (App + API)
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer
- **Timeline**: May 2022 – June 2025
- **Category**: Inventory & ERP Systems
- **Stack**: Angular, TypeScript, Hapi.js, MySQL, PostgreSQL, node-cron, bwip-js, SheetJS, Intuitive ERP, Juki Fortress
- **Key Highlights**:
  - Reduced API response times by 30–40% via profiling production queries, eliminating N+1 patterns, and refactoring bottlenecks.
  - Built warehouse modules for item receiving (barcode scanning), stocking, order picking, serial-number lifecycle tracking, BOM management, and shortage ticketing.
  - Developed responsive Angular frontend (ngx-datatable, Dragula drag-and-drop, bwip-js barcode generation, SheetJS import) with Hapi.js/MySQL REST APIs.
  - Integrated Intuitive ERP and Juki Fortress via bidirectional XML-to-JSON transforms with scheduled cron sync for automated reconciliation.
  - Implemented Jaro-Winkler fuzzy search and automated Nodemailer alerts for shortages and work-order updates.

### 6. WalletApp — Multi-Wallet Expense Tracking & Management API
- **Role**: Backend Engineer

  - Constructed Sequelize aggregation queries for real-time monthly budget totals and soft-delete audit trails.

  - Built administrative management panel with login audit tracking and device fingerprinting via node-device-detector.

## Generative AI Architecture Overview

- **Pipeline Workflow**: Resume Parsing (PDF/DOCX/Images) -> Pinecone Vector RAG Retrieval -> CrewAI Multi-Agent Task Routing -> OpenAI GPT-4o Structured Execution -> Real-Time SSE Streaming Output -> Automated ATS Audit & Scoring.
- **Stack**: FastAPI, CrewAI, OpenAI GPT-4o, Pinecone, RAG, SSE, Python.
